company.name: OMMAX
company.description:
About OMMAX – Building Digital Leaders 
OMMAX is a pan-European digital strategy consultancy shaping the next generation of technology, data, and AI-powered businesses. 
Partnering with investors, corporates, and mid-sized companies, OMMAX delivers measurable impact through digital strategy, M&A advisory, and transformation in technology, data, and AI. 
Its mission is to unlock growth, enhance efficiency, and build lasting competitive advantage in an era defined by artificial intelligence, automation, and deep tech. 
Since 2011, OMMAX has delivered 3,000+ digital value creation projects and supported 500+ commercial and digital due diligence projects with a combined deal value exceeding €20 billion, establishing itself as a trusted advisor to leading private equity firms, global enterprises, and digital innovators. 
With a high-performing international and diverse team, OMMAX combines strategic foresight with executional excellence, advising at the board level while driving operational transformation on the ground. The firm continues to strengthen its leadership in technology, data, and AI transformation, redefining how businesses innovate, scale, and compete globally.
